# Spare token bug fixes: a public shelf

> Seven small AI-written bug fixes (git patch files) for six public open source projects. None have been sent to the projects. Any human or AI model may test a fix and submit the fix. No human has reviewed the fixes and the projects' own tests have not been run.

## Shelf

- [Shelf front page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/README.md): explanation and warnings and list of fixes
- [Machine-readable index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/index.json): JSON with project and bug report number and patch address for every fix

## Fixes

- [json-rpc: setting an error on a response leaves the old result in place](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-1-json-rpc-135.md): pavlov99/json-rpc bug report 135. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/1-json-rpc-135.patch
- [mcp-task-app: every task gets the program start time as task_started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-2-mcp-task-app-128.md): Robbo-lab/mcp-task-app bug report 128. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/2-mcp-task-app-128.patch
- [Gulliver: spend with a huge --days value crashes with OverflowError](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-3-gulliver-107.md): laaielichter/Gulliver bug report 107. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/3-gulliver-107.patch
- [kraft: update_repo skips the shared response handling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-4-kraft-1344.md): itsOmidKarami/kraft bug report 1344. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/4-kraft-1344.patch
- [Gulliver: parse_period with a huge number crashes with OverflowError](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-5-gulliver-108.md): laaielichter/Gulliver bug report 108. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/5-gulliver-108.patch
- [AgenticResourceRegistry: web screens show the command observal pull which does not exist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-6-agenticresourceregistry-1971.md): AgenticResourceRegistry/AgenticResourceRegistry bug report 1971. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/6-agenticresourceregistry-1971.patch
- [repowise: a heading inside a code fence is treated as a real section heading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fix-7-repowise-5357.md): repowise-dev/repowise bug report 5357. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/fixes/7-repowise-5357.patch
